name: Summer Caprese Salad
description: Classic Italian salad showcasing peak-season tomatoes and fresh basil. Simple ingredients, maximum flavor.
instructions: Slice tomatoes into 1/4 inch thick rounds.
Slice mozzarella into similar-sized rounds.
Arrange alternating slices of tomato and mozzarella on a platter.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with sea salt and freshly cracked pepper.

name: Green Power Smoothie
description: A nutrient-packed smoothie blending seasonal kale with sweet fruits for an energizing start to your day.
instructions: Remove kale leaves from stems and roughly chop.
Add kale and almond milk to blender, blend until smooth.
Add blueberries, banana, and honey.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until creamy.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

name: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup
description: Velvety smooth autumn soup with warm spices. Roasting the squash first deepens the natural sweetness.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Halve the butternut squash, scoop out seeds, and drizzle with olive oil.
Roast cut-side down on a baking sheet for 40-45 minutes until tender.
Sauté diced onion and garlic in remaining olive oil until softened.
Scoop roasted squash flesh into the pot with onion mixture.
Add vegetable broth and bring to a simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend with an immersion blender until smooth.
Season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Serve warm.

name: Zucchini Noodles with Basil Pesto
description: Light, fresh, and full of summer flavor. Spiralized zucchini replaces pasta for a lower-carb seasonal meal.
instructions: Spiralize zucchini into noodles (or use a vegetable peeler for ribbons).
Make pesto: blend basil, pine nuts, parmesan, garlic, and olive oil until smooth.
Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Sauté zucchini noodles in a large pan over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes.
Toss with pesto and cherry tomatoes.
Serve immediately with extra parmesan on top.

name: Roasted Sweet Potato & Kale Bowl
description: A hearty, nutritious grain bowl featuring roasted sweet potatoes and massaged kale with a tangy dressing.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cube sweet potatoes, toss with olive oil and cumin, and roast for 25-30 minutes.
Cook quinoa according to package directions.
Remove kale stems and chop leaves. Massage with a drizzle of olive oil and lemon juice for 2 minutes.
Make dressing: whisk tahini, remaining lemon juice, and 2 tbsp warm water.
Assemble bowls: quinoa base, topped with kale, roasted sweet potato, and tahini dressing.
